comments.value:
In my world, I had to change the description drastically to reflect the update, and the changed description is difficult to understand.
私のワールドでは、アップデートに伴って大幅に記述を変更する必要があり、変更後の記述が分かりづらいものとなってしまっています。

I dont think reverting this feature is good idea, though i do agree that it's very confusing finding who's very poor avatar and whos not.
- better description on nameplate's fallback icon like "Fallback (Very Poor)"
- always show icon when nameplate is visible
i think these changes are enough to make easily describing the system and easier to understand without someone teaching.
JP:
この機能を前の状態に戻すのは反対ですが、アイコン等が分かりづらい問題に関してはすごく同意します。
- ネームプレートの表示を "Fallback (Very Poor)" 等に変更する
- Fallbackの表示をネームプレートが表示されている場合は常に表示する
だけで説明も楽になるし、わかりやすくなると思うのですがどうでしょうか?

Also, when you're playing on a Rift, you can't see what the icon is with your 1200p screen and your resolution scale at 60% because you're in Shelter and there's 70 people in the room
The "Fallback" text could be changed to "Filesize too large", or "Perf. Blocked" and so on.
Replacing the identical looking feather icons with ones that showcase the smaller but MUCH MORE IMPORTANT actual status icon, and making the feather into a badge in the corner of that would already be a huge improvement.
When UI 1.5 drops, the player-select hand menu should show the fallback status and why the avatar was blocked.

details:
(Sorry, I'm using Deepl translation)
In the community among VRChat Quest users in Japan, people often upload their own avatars with Very Poor Rank, and there is a culture of teaching beginners how to Show Avatar.
With the September 16 update, the Fallback Avatar specification has been changed, and whereas until now you could tell if a robot was PC Only or Very Poor by the thumbnail on the robot's chest
It is now necessary to open the menu and check the incomprehensible shit icon, making it difficult for beginners to understand.
Can you please change the avatar of Very Poor back to the old robot?
- Here is the original text
日本のVRChat Questユーザー間のコミュニティでは、自分専用のアバターを Very Poor Rank でアップロードすることが多く、Show Avatar の方法を初心者に教える文化があります。
9月16日のアップデートで、Fallback Avatar の仕様が変更されてしまい、今までは、ロボットの胸元にサムネイルが表示されているかでPC Only か Very Poor かの判別ができていたのに対し、
メニューを開いて、わかりづらいアイコンを確認することが必要になり、初心者にとって分かりづらい状態になってしまっています。
Very Poor のアバターだけでも、以前のロボットに戻していただけないでしょうか？
title: Please change the Fallback Avatar specification back to the old way / Fallback Avatar の仕様を以前の方法に戻してください
